acquisition method: MultiQuant 3.0.2 software (AB Sciex) was used to integrate the extracted MRM peaks.
cleavage agent: Target gel bands were cut out for in-gel trypsin (T4019; Sigma-Aldrich) digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
enrichment method: The proteins of interest were enriched using primary antibodies immobilized on Protein G agarose beads.
fractionation method: The enriched proteins were separated on 8–12% polyacrylamide gels.
instrument: the extracts were analyzed using Shimadzu LC Nexera X2 UHPLC coupled with a QTRAP 5500 LC MS/MS (AB Sciex).
labeling: Target gel bands were cut out for in-gel trypsin (T4019; Sigma-Aldrich) digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
